title: Question card with lettered choices
evidence: It works and looks as the oracle's 1.0.3 card (fixtures/states: oracle-ask-choice, oracle-choice-answered, a version exception, docs/decisions/0008). claude's AskUserQuestion arrives as Barkpark's approval_requested with the questions; components/Cards.tsx QuestionCard + styles/cards.css: the question in bold, a row per choice with a lettered square, 480 wide on rgb 31, radius 24; answered, only the chosen row with its square filled blue and the question dimmed. One single-choice question answers on a press (and shows the answered form while the answer is on its way); several questions or a pick-several are sent with Send once each has a choice (chat/api.ts answerQuestion posts /answer; Barkpark checks every choice). The status says "<bot> asked: <question>" as the oracle's does. scripts/behaviour.mjs: 3 rules. Live: npm run turn:live -- --question (2026-11-13: 3 choices offered, B pressed, the bot replied with that choice; parity/live/question.json). Missing: the answered card stays in the oracle's history; ours shows it only until the bot takes the answer (the live page clears an ask; Barkpark's stored approval rows would bring it back). The composer placeholder "Type your answer, or talk about something else" is ours while a question waits, but Gate A cannot read a placeholder (drawn, not in the DOM). Several questions and pick-several are not captured on the oracle, so their look is ours. The hover look of a choice is not captured.
gate: Gate A oracle-ask-choice 43/43, oracle-choice-answered 38/38 (card cases: scripts/lib/cards.mjs)
